FINAL ORDER OF THE COMMISSI ON
MULTIUNIT HORI ZONTA L WELL
The well was drilled
to a total measured
depth of25, 154 feet at a vertical
depth of 16 ,135
feet. 
6. 
Reason
Relief Should
Be Granted: 
The drilling
of the horizontal
well
as a multiunit
horizontal
well will prevent
both economic
waste
and a waste of hydrocarbons. 
It is less
expensive
to drill a longer lateral in a single horizontal
well then to drill two laterals
in two
separate
horizontal
wells. 
In addition, being permitted
to complete
and produce
the lateral
across
the section
line allows
for the production
of hydrocarbons
from
a larger
portion
of
the reservoir. 
If the completion
interval
must stop as it approaches
the section line and then
restart on the other side of the section line, the hydrocarbons
that are located
in the reservoir
on either side of the section
line may not be produced
by the wells. 
The common
sources
of supply
are approximately
the same thickness
and quality
across
the multiunit
area and
the
allocation
of costs
and
production
based
upon
a percentage
of completion
interval
within
each unit is fair and reasonable. 
7. 
Allowable: 
The well
shall
be permitted
to produce
1OOo/ o of a normal
allowable
for all
common
sources of supply
named
herein. 
8. 
Previous
Orders: Interim
Order No. 717449
is superseded
by this Final Order. 
9. 
Special Findings: 
The allocation
factor for each of the affected
units should
be determined
by dividing
the length of the completion
interval
from the multiunit
horizontal
well located
in each unit by the entire length of the completion
interval of the multiunit
horizontal
well. 
The completion
interval
of the multiunit
horizontal
well
is located
as follows: 
55.55o/ o in
Section
32 and 44.45o/ o in Section
5. The cost of and the production
and proceeds
from the
multiunit
horizontal
well should
be allocated
between
Sections
32 and 5 based
upon these
percentages. 
Attached
hereto
and marked
as Exhibit " A" is a map showing
the location
of
each
currently
existing
well
in
each
of the
affected
units
covered
hereby
and
the
approximate
location of the multiunit
horizontal
well. 
ORDER
10. 
IT IS THE ORDER OF THE COMMISSION that the relief requested in the Application , 
as modified
above , is necessary
to ensure
the greatest
ultimate
recovery
of hydrocarbons
from
the
above- mentioned
common
sources
of supply, prevent
or
assist
in preventing
waste, and protect correlative
rights of interested
parties.
